image_description: A close-up view of a bicycle wheel hub featuring a mechanical disc brake system. The image shows a silver, ventilated steel rotor with circular cutouts and ventilation holes, mounted to the center of a spoked wheel. A metallic caliper assembly is mounted to the bicycle fork (visible on the right), clamping onto the outer edge of the rotor. Black hydraulic or cable housing lines are visible connecting to the caliper.
